prompt: Fix the HTTP retry timing bug described in README.md without breaking existing consumers. Modify only http_retry.py and optional tests/*.py; preserve public APIs. Explain the cause, repair and verification in your final response. No dependency installation or commits.

review_criteria.evidence_before_change: Before first implementation edit, trace shows sufficient evidence of the live HTTP adapter, SDK seconds contract/version and existing worker caller. Reading retry_sdk.py supplies the authoritative declared2.4.0 seconds API; dependencies.lock is optional corroboration, not a mandatory file. Equivalent source inspection is accepted. Combined reads count; absent/truncated trace is unknown, not proof of noninspection. README alone is insufficient.
review_criteria.claim_correctness: Final cause identifies HTTP adapter unit mismatch against local SDK2.4 seconds contract; does not claim SDK delay is globally milliseconds or production deployment verified.
review_criteria.consumer_preservation: Repair confined to HTTP adapter; worker30-second behavior and SDK unchanged; tests demonstrate HTTP2500ms->2.5seconds.
review_criteria.attribution: Compare installed bundle arm against baseline; this shared practice is not an isolated source-first skill.
